record.one_liner: Pumble provides an API addon using API keys for sending messages, managing channels, and executing actions via HTTP requests.

auth_methods.quote: This addon lets you generate an API key that allows you to send messages, reactions, and more via simple HTTP requests.

access_test.quote: Available on all plans By using the Pumble API addon, you can interact with Pumble’s API documentation without using any complex authentication processes.

access_ship.quote: Available on all plans By using the Pumble API addon, you can interact with Pumble’s API documentation without using any complex authentication processes.

api_type.quote: The full list of available actions is available in the Swagger documentation. You can also use the documentation in Swagger, just enter your API key in the Authorize part.

api_breadth.quote: The generated key enables interaction with the Addon’s public API, allowing users to send requests and execute various actions within Pumble, including: Sending messages Leaving a reply to a message Message deletion Adding a reaction to a message Channel creation Listing the messages in a channel
